resources.string: Settings and accounts to a file, and back
BirdSocks\' settings as a plain JSON file, for this phone or another. Passwords, NetBird accounts and this device\'s name stay out: after a restore, enter the proxy passwords again and sign in.
The settings with their passwords and the NetBird accounts with their keys, in one file locked with a password. For this phone after a reinstall.
A settings file or a full backup. Nothing changes before you confirm what to restore.
The file will hold the keys of your NetBird accounts and your passwords, encrypted with this password. It cannot be recovered: without it the backup cannot be restored.
The password was lost while the file was being chosen. Start the backup again.
Enter the password the backup was saved with.
Wrong password, or the file is damaged

%1$s.\n\nThe settings in the file replace the ones here. Passwords, NetBird accounts and this device\'s name are not in it and stay as they are. Sharing the proxy on the local network stays off while the proxy has no password here.
The settings and their passwords. The NetBird accounts here stay as they are.
Also the NetBird accounts with their keys, in place of the ones here, and this device\'s name. NetBird stops while they are written and starts again.
Restoring NetBird keys on another phone makes two devices share one identity. Use it on the same phone (after a reinstall), or sign in again on a new one.
